calibration_baseline: V15 Review Agent 90/100; V16 Review Agent 88/100

findings.finding: V16 let planning context and warning states displace the buildable civic cross in the actual scoring entrances.
findings.remediation: Make the 4 m invariant route, one-sided bay, staffed Receipt Porch and four civic states the first visual judgement; retain approved planning as the credible base.
findings.verification: The 18-image official-scale packet shows the spatial prototype in both PDF first pages and interactive first screens, while G0 remains a small preparation badge.

findings.finding: Earlier core figures reused diagram families and did not give land use or mobility a locatable spatial role.
findings.remediation: Assign five non-overlapping duties: city context, ground interface, landmark family, continuous journey and evidence ledger.
findings.verification: Canonical QA confirms five unique hashes per language; 1024 px contact review confirms distinct primary compositions.

findings.finding: The first A3 draft repeated the evidence ledger and left the Ring and Gate prototype pages under-developed.
findings.remediation: Replace page 2 with a 90-second route and rebuild pages 8–9 with their own experience, plan, section and evidence decisions.
findings.verification: All 38 PDF pages were rendered at 150 DPI; contact and full-page review found no duplicate page, blank, clipping or garbled text.

findings.finding: The report first-screen draft vertically centred a short panel and left a large non-design blank area; the English scene caption also joined two evidence labels.
findings.remediation: Top-align the report evidence panel, tighten its height and apply a shared flex gap to bilingual scene labels.
findings.verification: Desktop 1440×1600 and mobile 390×844 screenshots show the task index and prototype immediately, with no horizontal overflow.

findings.finding: V11–V16 override functions and separately maintained app/styles assets created a content-drift risk.
findings.remediation: Use one canonical content, spatial, publication, HTML and QA chain; remove unconsumed app.js and styles.css.
findings.verification: Build QA rejects Legacy or V11–V16 override signatures and confirms removed assets are absent from disk and manifest.

findings.finding: Official survey, ownership, exact entrances, utilities and observed flows remain unavailable.
findings.remediation: Keep interface bands and prototype dimensions provisional; verify them before G1.

findings.finding: No scene has been field-run; permits are 0/8 and baseline recording is 0/7 days.
findings.remediation: Remain at G0 survey and permit preparation; do not issue adopt/revise/stop before controlled evidence exists.

findings.finding: Public OSM context is incomplete and cannot establish statutory or engineering accuracy.
findings.remediation: Use it only as low-contrast context and reconcile the prototype against professional survey and approved base drawings.
